tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground. Warm ivory instead of pure white: the single biggest step from 'shop' to 'store'. ink, ink-muted, green and terracotta all read on it.

tokens.name: paper-deep
tokens.usage: Alternate section ground (editorial split, order steps) and the sand photo backdrop. ink and ink-muted read on it; do not set terracotta text on it (4.1:1).

tokens.name: sand-deep
tokens.usage: Plinth and floor inside a sand (paper-deep) photo slot. Decorative only.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Inputs, basket drawer, text on terracotta and ink buttons. Not a page ground any more.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline rules between sections, under the header, between category rows. Decorative: never the only thing that marks a control.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Brand ink (unchanged from the shop). All body copy and headings on paper, paper-deep, sage and clay (13:1 and up). Fill of the primary button.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy: brand names on cards, sub-category lists, captions. On paper 6.3:1, paper-deep 5.6:1, sage 5.2:1, clay 5.0:1.

tokens.name: forest
tokens.usage: Deep evolution of brand green for large dark surfaces: announcement bar, hero panel, footer. Carries on-forest, on-forest-muted and gold.

tokens.name: forest-line
tokens.usage: Hairlines on forest (footer column rules). Decorative only.

tokens.name: on-forest
tokens.usage: Headlines and body on forest (11.2:1). Fill of the light button that sits on forest.

tokens.name: on-forest-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy and footer links on forest (7.1:1).

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: The shop's brand green. Text accents and links on paper (5.8:1) and white (6.6:1), the focus ring on light grounds, the green blocks of the brand band.

tokens.name: terracotta
tokens.usage: The shop's orange-dark, promoted to the money colour: fill of every 'Order on WhatsApp' button with white text (5.2:1), sale prices and Sale badges on paper (4.6:1) and white.

tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: The shopfront orange. Only in the brand band and the cover. Never behind text: white on it is 3.4:1.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Small accents on forest only: eyebrow labels (6.9:1), the basket count dot, the focus ring on dark grounds. Invisible on paper (1.6:1): never use it there.

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: Photo backdrop tone 1 (kitchen appliances, laundry). Product shots sit on it.

tokens.name: sage-deep
tokens.usage: Plinth and floor inside a sage photo slot. Decorative only.

tokens.name: clay
tokens.usage: Photo backdrop tone 2 (cooking, storage, kids). Product shots sit on it.

tokens.name: clay-deep
tokens.usage: Plinth and floor inside a clay photo slot. Decorative only.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring on paper, paper-deep, white, sage and clay: 2px solid, 3px offset (5.2:1 or better on each). On forest the ring switches to gold.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.sample: Good things for the home you are building
styles.usage: Hero headline on desktop. One per page.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Section openers on desktop; the hero headline on phones.

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: Section headings on phones, category index rows on desktop.

styles.name: display-sm
styles.usage: Step titles, footer wordmark, basket heading.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Blenders, kettles, storage and laundry essentials, chosen for Ghanaian homes.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Pick what you like and order straight on WhatsApp.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Product names on cards, sub-category lists, footer links.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: Prices, with tabular figures. Always formatted 'GH₵ 450' / 'GH₵ 1,250.50'.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows, badges, buttons, announcement bar. Always uppercase.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Badge padding, brand line to name on cards.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Photo to text on product cards.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Phone side gutter, grid gap on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Grid gap on desktop, button side padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Desktop side gutter, heading to content.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Hero panel padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop. Generous space is what reads as expensive: do not tighten it.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Photos, cards, tiles, buttons. The system is square.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs and badges only.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: The basket count dot only.

tokens.name: shadow-drawer
tokens.usage: The basket drawer and search overlay. Nothing on the page itself casts a shadow.

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: Max content width.

tokens.name: tap
tokens.usage: Minimum height of every button, link row and icon button.

tokens.name: header-h
tokens.usage: Header height on desktop (60px on phones).
